name: Render
description: Client-side visuals only: highlights for blocks, items, projectiles, TNT and the block you aim at, trails, jump and kill effects, waypoints and light levels, plus a setting toggle that turns view bobbing off. Nothing here sends packets.

addons.NoBob: Turns off view bobbing while enabled and gives the setting back when disabled.
addons.ItemESP: Highlights dropped items through walls within a chosen range, in the theme colour.
addons.ProjectileESP: Highlights arrows, fireballs, ender pearls and other thrown items through walls, each in its own colour.
addons.TNTTimer: Outlines primed TNT through walls and lists the closest ones with the seconds left on their fuse.
addons.BlockOverlay: Outlines the block your crosshair is on. Follows the silent rotation, so it shows what your clicks would hit.
addons.BlockESP: Highlights the block types you list (bed, diamond_ore, tnt...) through walls within a range.
addons.DamageParticles: Floats the damage of each of your hits over the target, rising and fading.
addons.JumpCircles: Draws a ring under you when you jump, growing and fading.
addons.PlayerTrail: A fading trail behind each other player through their last positions.
addons.KillEffect: Draws a burst where a kill you made happens.
addons.WaypointMarkers: Named world points shown as beams. Add with .waypoint add <name>, remove, list and clear.
addons.LightLevel: Shows the light level on the ground around you, red where hostile mobs can spawn.
addons.DeathMarker: Marks where you last died with a beam and the distance. Clear button removes it.
addons.CustomFov: Sets the camera field of view, with a separate value while sprinting.
addons.Zoom: Hold a key to narrow the camera field of view.
addons.AntiBlind: Removes the blindness and nausea effects on your client.
addons.Ambience: Sets a client-side time of day and clear weather.
addons.RangeRing: Draws a ring on the ground at your reach.
